prompt.project_info: Create a raw-photography candid street portrait of an approved adult woman enjoying melting vanilla ice cream on a sunny European-style urban street.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long straight blonde hair and sun-kissed highlights, natural fair skin texture, and a joyful open-mouth laugh while looking slightly aside. She wears a light heather-grey athletic sleeveless top, white wired earphones, small gold hoops, layered gold jewelry, and a two-tone metal watch.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium close-up centered on the subject holding a melting waffle cone near her mouth and a partially visible smartphone. Include terracotta and cream buildings, green shutters, parked scooters, and greenery in the street background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright direct summer sunlight with high contrast and defined shadows, warm natural colors, realistic skin and fabric texture, spontaneous upbeat street mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Raw documentary photography, 4:5 vertical framing, high-fidelity detail, ISO 100, 1/250s, natural colors, fine grain, no post-processing look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a raw-photography 4:5 candid street portrait of an approved adult blonde woman laughing joyfully while holding a melting vanilla ice-cream cone near her mouth and a partially visible smartphone. Give her long straight sun-kissed blonde hair, natural fair skin texture, white wired earphones, small gold hoops, layered gold jewelry, and a two-tone metal watch. Dress her in a light heather-grey athletic sleeveless top. Place her on a sunny European-style street with terracotta and cream buildings, green shutters, parked scooters, and greenery. Use bright direct sunlight, crisp natural shadows, realistic textures, ISO 100, 1/250s, natural colors, and fine grain.
